$comment: Rules for scripts/safety-guard.ts. This repo is public: the guard blocks secrets, personal home paths, real e-mail addresses, public IPv4 literals and denylisted words, in files and in commit metadata. Only public rules live here. Private words go in .safety-guard.local.json (git-ignored, read from the checkout and from the main clone of a worktree, as 'words' or sha256 'hashedWords') or in the comma-separated SAFETY_GUARD_WORDS variable, never in this file. Private words are only ever reported as '(private word)'. Silence one line with the marker 'safety-guard: allow' and say why next to it.
allowEmailsReason: The project's contact address is public on purpose.
